Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Ms. Shaifali Singh, Advocate, for the 
petitioner.
Mrs. Anjali Bhargava, Addl. CSC, for the 
State.
The challenge in the writ petition is given 
to the order dated 02.11.2021, passed by 
respondent No. 2, whereby the petitioner’s claim 
for regularisation as a class-IV employee has been 
rejected in compliance of the judgement dated 
25.02.2021, which was rendered in Writ Petition 
(S/S) No. 711 of 2018.
The respondents, who are represented by 
the learned Addl. CSC, pray for and are granted 
three weeks’ time to file counter affidavit.
List thereafter.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
